title: Deaths mount, trauma sets in as Russia ramps up missile attacks on Ukraine
english: Russia has intensified its missile and drone strikes on Ukraine, marking July as the deadliest month of the conflict since 2022. Due to a critical shortage of Western air defense systems, many civilians have been killed or injured in strikes on residential and public areas. These attacks are leaving families devastated and causing long-term psychological trauma for survivors who have lost loved ones and homes.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ የምታደርገውን የሚሳኤል እና ድሮን ጥቃት አጠናክራ በመቀጠሏ፣ ሐምሌ ወር ከ2022 ወዲህ እጅግ አሰቃቂ የሞት ቁጥር የተመዘገበበት ወር ሆኗል። የምዕራባውያን የአየር መከላከያ ሥርዓቶች እጥረት በመኖሩ፣ በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎች በመኖሪያ እና በሕዝብ ቦታዎች ላይ በሚደርሱ ጥቃቶች ሕይወታቸውን እያጡ እና እየቆሰሉ ነው። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ቤተሰቦችን ከማፈናቀላቸውም በላይ፣ የሚወዷቸውን ያጡ እና መኖሪያ ቤታቸው የወደመባቸው ሰዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እየፈጠሩ ነው።
oromo: Raashiyaan haleellaa ishee isa misaa'elaa fi dooniiwwan (drones) ukreen irratti dabaluun, ji'a Adooleessaa bara 2022 as ji'a namoonni hedduun itti du'an taasifteetti. Sirnoonni ittisa qilleensaa kan dhihaa gahaa ta'uu dhabuun, namoonni nagaan hedduun haleellaa bakka jireenyaa fi bakka uummataa irratti raawwatameen du'uu fi miidhamuu gadhiseera. Haleellaan kun maatiiwwan miidhuu qofa osoo hin taane, namoota jaallatamoo isaanii dhabanii fi mana isaanii dhaban irratti miidhaa sammuu (trauma) kan yeroo dheeraa fiduu irra jira.

title: India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement makes schools next battleground against Modi
english: The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), an Indian activist group that recently forced the resignation of the education minister, has launched a new campaign to audit the poor conditions of government-funded schools. During a local school inspection, a young activist named Abdul Hafeez was attacked by suspected political opponents, resulting in the death of his father. Despite this tragedy, the group remains committed to holding the government accountable for improving infrastructure, sanitation, and resources in public schools.
amharic: የህንድ 'ኮክሮች ጃናታ ፓርቲ' የተባለ የተቃውሞ ቡድን፣ የሀገሪቱን የመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች ሁኔታ ለመገምገም አዲስ ዘመቻ ጀምሯል። ቡድኑ ከዚህ ቀደም የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ እንዲለቁ በማድረግ ስኬት አስመዝግቦ ነበር። ሆኖም በአንድ ትምህርት ቤት ምርመራ ወቅት የተከሰተ ጥቃት የነቃ ተሟጋች አባት ህይወት እንዲያልፍ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ቢኖርም፣ ቡድኑ ለትምህርት ቤቶች የተሻለ መሰረተ ልማት እና አቅርቦት ለመጠየቅ የሚያደርገውን እንቅስቃሴ እንደማያቆም አስታውቋል።
oromo: gareen mormituu Hindii 'Cockroach Janata Party' jedhamu, haala manneen barnoota mootummaa fooyyessuuf duula haaraa jalqabeera. Gareen kun kanaan dura ministira barnootaa aangoo akka gad-lisan dirqisiisuun isaa ni yaadatama. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoo mana barnootaa tokko irratti namoota hidhata siyaasaa qaban jedhaman irraan miidhaa geessifameen, gargaaraa dargaggeessa tokkoo abbaan isaa du'aan boqoteera. Balaa kana keessatti illee, gareen kun manneen barnoota mootummaa keessatti qulqullinaa fi bu'uuraalee barnootaa fooyyessuuf gaaffii isaanii akka itti fufan ibsaniiru.

title: Asian Champions League draw: Holders Al-Ahli to face former winners Al Ain
english: The Asian Champions League Elite draw has paired the reigning champions, Al-Ahli, against former winners Al Ain in an expanded 32-team league phase. These teams will also compete against Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al-Nassr and various other regional clubs starting in September. The tournament will conclude with the final stages held in Saudi Arabia next spring.
amharic: የእስያ ሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ኤሊት የዕጣ ማውጣት ስነ-ስርዓት የአሁኑ ሻምፒዮን አል-አህሊ ከቀድሞው አሸናፊ አል-አይን ጋር እንዲፋለሙ አድርጓል። በ32 ቡድኖች በተስፋፋው በዚህ የሊግ ውድድር፣ ክለቦቹ ከክርስቲያኖ ሮናልዶው አል-ናስር እና ከሌሎች የክልሉ ቡድኖች ጋር ይጫወታሉ። ውድድሩ በመስከረም ወር ተጀምሮ በሚቀጥለው የፀደይ ወቅት በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሚደረጉ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታዎች ይጠናቀቃል።
oromo: Guyyaan tapha ‘Asian Champions League Elite’ qophaa’e, qabxii qabeessi ammaa Al-Ahli fi injifattoota darbe Al Ain waliin akka wal-morkatan godheera. Gareewwan kunneen tapha liigii miseensa 32 qabu kana keessatti garee Cristiano Ronaldo kan ta’e Al-Nassr fi gareewwan biroo waliin morkatu. Taphoonni kunneen Hagayya booda kan jalqaban yoo ta’u, xumura isaanii gara fuulduraatti biyya Sa’ud Arabiyaatti kan geggeeffamu ta’a.

title: Eight air strikes hit airbase in Syria’s Idlib
english: Eight air strikes recently targeted the Abu al-Duhur military base in Syria's Idlib province, causing significant damage to the runway. Syrian state media identified the Israeli military as the party responsible for the attack, though Israel has not provided a comment. This marks the first strike on the facility since the fall of the Assad regime, highlighting an ongoing campaign to limit Syrian military capabilities.
amharic: ስምንት የአየር ጥቃቶች በቅርቡ በሶሪያ ኢድሊብ ግዛት በሚገኘው የአቡ አል-ዱሁር ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ ተፈጽመዋል፣ ይህም በማኮያው መንገድ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የሶሪያ የመንግስት ሚዲያ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል እንደሆነ የገለጸ ሲሆን እስራኤል ግን እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት አስተያየት አልሰጠችም። ይህ የአስድ መንግስት ከወደቀ በኋላ በጣቢያው ላይ ሲፈጸም የመጀመሪያው ጥቃት ሲሆን፣ የሶሪያን ወታደራዊ አቅም ለመገደብ የታቀደ ዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ታምኖበታል።
oromo: Humni qilleensaa Israa'el iddoo waraanaa Abu al-Duhur kan naannoo Idlib, Siiriyaa irratti qilleensaan haleellaa saddeet gaggeessiteera. Haleellaan kun bakka xiyyaarri buutu irratti miidhaa guddaa kan qaqqabsiise yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti humni waraanaa Israa'el waan jedhe tokko hin jiru. Kunis mootummaan Bashar al-Asaad erga kufee as iddoo sana irratti haleellaa raawwatame isa jalqabaa yoo ta'u, haleellaan kun dandeettii waraana Siiriyaa laaffisuuf kan karoorfame fakkaata.

title: Brazil’s president says Amazon oil is ‘passport to the future’
english: Brazilian President Lula da Silva has defended the exploration of oil deposits found off the Amazon coast, labeling the discovery as vital for the nation's progress. While environmental groups strongly oppose drilling in this sensitive region, the president argues that the project will bolster Brazil's economic independence and sovereignty. He views these resources as a key asset for the country's development in the coming years.
amharic: የብራዚሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉኢዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ በአማዞን የባህር ዳርቻ የተገኘውን የነዳጅ ሀብት ለሀገሪቱ የወደፊት ዕድገት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ተሟጋቾች በስፍራው የሚደረገውን የነዳጅ ቁፋሮ በጽኑ ቢቃወሙም፣ ፕሬዚዳንቱ ፕሮጀክቱ የብራዚልን የኢኮኖሚ ነጻነት እንደሚያጠናክር ይከራከራሉ። ይህን የነዳጅ ክምችት የሀገሪቱን ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ለማስጠበቅ እንደ ትልቅ ዕድል እንደሚመለከቱት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin biyya Braazil Lula da Siilvaa, qabeenyi boba’aa qarqara laga Amaazoonitti argame, gara fuulduraatti biyyattii fayyaduu fi guddinaaf murteessaa ta’uu ibsaniiru. Gareewwan eegumsa naannoo qonnaan boba’aa kanaa mormaa jiranus, pirezedantichi hojiin kun guddina diinagdee fi bilisummaa biyyattii kan cimsamu ta’uu dubbatu. Innis, boba’aa kana guddina biyyattii ittiin ariifachiisuufi madda humnaa guddaa akka ta’e himaniiru.

title: Syrian man dies in custody after alleged abuse by security officers
english: A Syrian man has passed away while in police detention following claims that he was brutally beaten by security personnel. His family stated that they had cautioned officers about his haemophilia condition prior to the alleged abuse. In response to the outcry, the Syrian Interior Ministry has taken seven officers into custody to face an investigation regarding the incident.
amharic: አንድ ሶሪያዊ ሰው በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር እያለ በደረሰበት ድብደባ ህይወቱ ማለፉን ቤተሰቦቹ ገልጸዋል። ቤተሰቦቹ ከመሞቱ በፊት ለፖሊስ የደም መርጋት ችግር (ሄሞፊሊያ) እንዳለበት አስቀድመው ነግረዋቸው እንደነበር ተናግረዋል። ይህንን ተከትሎ የሶሪያ የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ከድርጊቱ ጋር በተያያዘ ሰባት የጸጥታ አካላትን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሎ ምርመራ እየጀመረ ነው።
oromo: Namni Soriyaa tokko yeroo to'annaa poolisii jiru keessatti reebicha irra ga'een du'uu isaa maatiin isaa ibsaniiru. Maatiin namichaa akka jedhanitti, dhukkuba dhiigni itti hin citte (haemophilia) qabaachuu isaa erga himanii booda poolisonni reebicha irratti raawwachuu isaanii dubbatu. Haala kanaan walqabatee, Ministeerri Dhimma Keessaa Soriyaa poolisoota torba to'annaa jala oolchuun qorannoo jalqabeera.

title: Meta lawsuits: Is social media facing a global legal reckoning?
english: Meta is facing a significant lawsuit in the United States brought by 29 states that accuse the company of creating addictive platforms that harm the mental health of children. The legal action challenges specific features like continuous scrolling and data collection practices, potentially costing the company over a trillion dollars in damages. Beyond financial penalties, the states are demanding major technical changes to Meta’s apps to better protect young users and ensure parental oversight.
amharic: ሜታ በአሜሪካ የ29 ግዛቶች ጥምረት የቀረበበት ከፍተኛ ክስ እየገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ኩባንያው የህፃናትን የአእምሮ ጤና የሚጎዱ ሱስ አስያዥ መድረኮችን ገንብቷል በሚል ይወቀሳል። የክሱ አቅራቢዎች በተለይ የማያቋርጥ የገጽ መግለጥ ባህሪን እና የግል መረጃ አያያዝን በመተቸት፣ ኩባንያው በአንድ ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የገንዘብ ቅጣት ሊጣልበት እንደሚችል ይናገራሉ። ከገንዘብ ቅጣቱ በተጨማሪ፣ የህግ ባለሙያዎች ሜታ ወጣቶችን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል የመተግበሪያዎቹን አሰራር እንዲቀይር እና የወላጆችን ቁጥጥር እንዲያጠናክር እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Meta dhaabbata isaa irratti himannaan guddaan biyyoota US 29 irraa dhiyaateen wal qabatee rakkoo keessa galeera. Himannaan kun Meta fiilmoota fi appilikeeshinoota dargaggootaaf midhaa sammuu geessisaniifi barattoota irratti qabachuu fi qabiyyee isaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatuudha. Himannaan kun dhaabbaticharraa qarshii tiriliyoona tokkoo ol akka gaafatamuuf kan taasisu ta'uu fi dhaabbatichi akkaataa itti fayyadama appilikeeshinoota isaa jijjiiruu qaba jedhamee amanama. Kana malees, hirmaattonni himannichaa Meta sirna to'annoo warraaf mijataa ta'e akka diriirsuu fi dhimmoota nageenya dargaggootaa irratti jijjiirama bu'uuraa akka fidu gaafataniiru.

title: Infantino’s FIFA World Cup fallout: Lamour exits after criticism of plan
english: FIFA Chief Operating Officer Kevin Lamour has left the organization following his vocal opposition to Gianni Infantino’s controversial plan to sell commercial stakes in the World Cup. Lamour had publicly accused the FIFA president of prioritizing personal interests over the organization's mission, contributing to the plan's eventual withdrawal. This internal conflict has weakened Infantino's standing as he faces growing pressure and a more uncertain path toward his reelection next year.
amharic: የፊፋ ዋና ኦፕሬቲንግ ኦፊሰር የሆኑት ኬቨን ላሞር፣ የዓለም ዋንጫን የንግድ መብቶች ለመሸጥ በጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የቀረበውን አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ በይፋ በመቃወማቸው ከድርጅቱ ለቀዋል። ላሞር የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንቱ የድርጅቱን ተልዕኮ ወደ ጎን በመተው ለግል ጥቅማቸው ቅድሚያ ሰጥተዋል ሲሉ ወቅሰዋል። ይህ ክስተት በኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የፈጠረ ሲሆን በሚቀጥለው ዓመት ለሚካሄደው ምርጫ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ጥያቄ ውስጥ ከቷል።
oromo: Hogganaan olaanaan hoji raawwachiiftuu FIFA Keveen Laamoor, yaada gabaa waancaa addunyaa irratti qooda gurguruuf jiyaani Iinfaantiinoo dhiyeesse mormuusaatiin dhaabbatichaa gadhiiseera. Laamoor piirezidaantichi FIFA akka dhaabbataatti osoo hin taane fedhii dhuunfaa isaatiif akka hojjechaa jiru himatee ture; kunis yaadrimee kana akka dhaabbatu godheera. Falmiin keessaa kun, Iinfaantiinoon fuuldura isaatti filannoo marsaa ittaanuuf qabu irratti shakkiifi mormii cimaa akka mudatu isa taasiseera.

title: Videos show deadly school shooting in Philippines
english: A ninth-grade student carried out a fatal shooting at a high school in Zamboanga, Philippines. The attack resulted in the deaths of the shooter and one classmate, while two other students sustained injuries. Reports suggest that the violence was broadcast live on the internet by the perpetrator.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ዛምቦአንጋ በሚገኝ አንድ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት የዘጠነኛ ክፍል ተማሪ በፈጸመው የተኩስ አደጋ ህይወቱ አልፏል። በዚሁ ጥቃት ተማሪው ራሱን ከመግደሉም በላይ የአንድ ተማሪ ህይወት እንዲያልፍ እና የሁለት ሌሎች ተማሪዎች ጉዳት እንዲደርስ አድርጓል። ተማሪው ይህንኑ ጥቃት በኢንተርኔት በቀጥታ እንዳስተላለፈው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Filippinsii keessatti mana barnoota sadarkaa lammaffaa Zamboangatti barataan kutaa saglaffaa tokko dhukaasa baneen lubbuun darbeera. Hojii badii kanaan barataan kun ofis ajjeesee, barataa tokkos ajjeesee, barattoota biroo lama immoo miidheera. Barataan kun yakka raawwate kana miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti kallattiin darbaa akka ture gabaasameera.

title: Pakistan top court orders Imran Khan’s hospital transfer amid access battle
english: Pakistan's Supreme Court has ordered former Prime Minister Imran Khan to be moved from prison to a hospital for medical treatment following concerns about his blood pressure and heart health. The court-mandated stay allows him to be treated by his own doctors and visit with his family for at least a month. Khan has been incarcerated since 2023 on various charges, which he and his supporters maintain are politically driven.
amharic: የፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን የደም ግፊት እና የልብ ጤንነታቸው መታወኩን ተከትሎ ከእስር ቤት ወደ ሆስፒታል እንዲዛወሩ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥቷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ካን ለተወሰኑ ሳምንታት በራሳቸው ሀኪሞች እንዲታከሙና ከቤተሰቦቻቸው ጋር እንዲገናኙ ፈቅዷል። ኢምራን ካን ከ2023 ጀምሮ በተለያዩ ክሶች በእስር ላይ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ እርሳቸውና ደጋፊዎቻቸው ክሱ ፖለቲካዊ መሰረት ያለው መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Paakistaanitti dura ta'aa mootummaa duraanii Imraan Khaan dhibee dhiibbaa dhiigaa fi onnee isaanii irratti xiyyeeffachuun, manni hidhaa gadhiissee gara hospitaalaatti akka geessaman ajajee jira. Murtii kanaan, Khaan hospitaala keessatti baatii tokkoof oolanii, ogeeyyii fayyaa isaan filataniin akka yaalaman akkasumas maatii isaanii wajjin akka wal argan hayyamameef jira. Khaan bara 2023 irraa eegalee himannaa garaa garaatiin hidhaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, isaanis ta'e deggertoonni isaanii himannaan kun duula siyaasaa akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Cincinnati Open: Williams sisters fall in doubles while Zverev advances
english: In the Cincinnati Open, Alexander Zverev secured a hard-fought victory against Terrance Atmane to reach the fourth round. Meanwhile, sisters Serena and Venus Williams played their first doubles match together in four years but were ultimately defeated in a tie-break. Other players like Alex de Minaur also progressed to the next round despite difficult weather conditions caused by rain.
amharic: በሲንሲናቲ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር ላይ አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ ተጋጣሚውን ተርንስ አትማንን በማሸነፍ ወደ አራተኛው ዙር አልፏል። በሌላ በኩል ሴሬና እና ቪነስ ዊሊያምስ ለአራት ዓመታት ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በአንድ ላይ በድርብ ውድድር ቢሳተፉም በመጨረሻ ተሸንፈዋል። እንዲሁም አሌክስ ደ ሚናር በተደጋጋሚ ዝናብ እና ሌሎች ፈታኝ ሁኔታዎች ቢኖሩም ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር ማለፍ ችሏል።
oromo: Dorgommii Cincinnati Open irratti, Aleksandar Zverev morkataa isaa Terrance Atmane injifachuun gara sadarkaa afuraffaatti darbeera. Gamtaan obboleewwan Serina fi Vinas Wiliyaams waggaa afur booda walta'anii taphatanis, injifannoo argachuu osoo hin danda'in hafaniiru. Taphattoonni biroo kanneen akka Aleks de Minaar immoo, rakkoo roobaan uumame hunda dandamatanii gara sadarkaa itti aanutti darbuu danda'aniiru.

title: Hormuz Strait to remain closed until US meets interim deal conditions, says Iran
english: Iran has announced that the Strait of Hormuz will stay blocked until the United States complies with the terms of their interim agreement. Iranian negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that the U.S. must remove marine blockades and economic sanctions while also releasing frozen Iranian funds. Tehran intends to keep this vital shipping route closed until these specific demands are addressed.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በእሷ መካከል የተደረሰውን ጊዜያዊ ስምምነት እስክታከብር ድረስ ዝግ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቃለች። የኢራን ዋና ተደራዳሪ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ እንደገለጹት አሜሪካ ማዕቀቦችን ማንሳት፣ የባህር ላይ እገዳዎችን ማቆም እና የታገዱ የኢራን ንብረቶችን መልቀቅ አለባት። እነዚህ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስኪሟሉ ድረስ ወሳኙ የባህር መስመር ዝግ እንደሚሆን ተነግሯል።
oromo: Iraan daandiin galaana Hormuz hamma yeroo Ameerikaan walii galtee yerootii isaanii waliin mallatteessite kabajutti cufaa ta'ee akka turu beeksisteetti. Mari'achiisaan olaanaan Iraan Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaf akka ibsanitti, Ameerikaan uggura diinagdee fi kan galaana irraa kaasuu akkasumas qabeenya Iraan kan kanaan dura uggurame gadhiisuu qabdi. Iraan gaaffiiwwan kunneen hamma deebii argatutti daandiin kun cufaa ta'ee akka turu murteessiteetti.

title: Trump lashes out at CNN reporter over South Korea question
english: Donald Trump reacted angrily to a CNN reporter during a media event after being questioned about potential military drill reductions in South Korea. The former president dismissed the journalist, labeling them as a fake reporter rather than answering the inquiry about North Korea. This interaction highlights the ongoing tensions between Trump and certain news organizations.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር በሚደረጉ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶች ዙሪያ ጥያቄ ያቀረበላቸውን የሲኤንኤን ጋዜጠኛ በቁጣ አጣጥለዋል። የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ለጋዜጠኛው የሐሰት ዘጋቢ ናቸው በማለት ጥያቄውን ከመመለስ ተቆጥበዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በፕሬዝዳንቱ እና በአንዳንድ የዜና አውታሮች መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Donald Traamp gaaffii gaazexeessaan CNN tokko shaakala waraanaa Koriyaa Kibbaa wajjin walqabatee dhiyeesseef dheekkamsaan deebisaniiru. Dura ta'aan kun gaazexeessicha 'gaazexeessaa sobaa' jechuun waamuun, gaaffii wa'ee Koriyaa Kaabaa dhiyeeffamef deebii kennuu didaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun hariiroo cimaa Traampii fi dhaabbilee miidiyaa tokko tokko gidduu jiru agarsiisa.

title: Syrian court sentences Wassim al-Assad to death
english: A Syrian court has handed a death sentence to Wassim al-Assad, a cousin of former leader Bashar al-Assad. He was convicted of serious crimes committed during the civil war, such as intentional murder and torture. This legal action follows recent similar death sentences issued against other top members of the former regime, including Bashar al-Assad himself.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞው መሪ ባሻር አል-አሳድ የአጎት ልጅ የሆኑትን ዋሲም አል-አሳድን በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወስኗል። ዋሲም አል-አሳድ በአገሪቱ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት ወቅት በፈጸሟቸው እንደ ግድያ እና ስቃይ ባሉ ከባድ ወንጀሎች ጥፋተኛ ተብለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከጥቂት ቀናት በፊት በባሻር አል-አሳድ እና በሌሎች የቀድሞው መንግስት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ላይ ከተላለፈው ተመሳሳይ የሞት ቅጣት ጋር ተያያዥነት ያለው ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Siriyaatti, wasiila hogganaa duraanii Bashar Al-Asaad kan ta'an Wassim Al-Asaad irratti adabbii du'aa murteesse. Wassim Al-Asaad waraana cimaa biyyattii keessatti yakka ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwataniin himatamuun irratti mirkanaa'eera. Murteen kun, guyyoota muraasa dura Bashar Al-Asaad dabalatee qondaalota sirnichaa biroo irratti adabbiin du'aa dabarsuu isaanii hordofee kan dhufe dha.

title: Chinese company unveils new ‘Superman’ humanoid robot
english: A Chinese startup named Unitree has introduced a new humanoid robot dubbed Superman. The robot is designed for impressive physical performance, featuring the ability to leap two meters high. Furthermore, the company claims it can outrun the fastest human over a 100-meter distance.
amharic: ዩኒትሪ የተሰኘ የቻይና ኩባንያ 'ሱፐርማን' የተሰኘ አዲስ የሰው መልክ ያለው ሮቦት ይፋ አድርጓል። ሮቦቱ ሁለት ሜትር ከፍታ ላይ መዝለል የሚችል ሲሆን፤ የኩባንያው መረጃ እንደሚያመለክተው ደግሞ በ100 ሜትር ሩጫ ከማንኛውም ሰው በበለጠ ፍጥነት መሮጥ ይችላል።
oromo: Qoqqooddoota Chaayinaa kan ta'an Unitree jedhaman, 'Superman' kan jedhamu fi bifa namaa fakkaatu qabuufi konkolaataa elektirooniksii haaraa hojjetan. Roobootti kun meetira lama ol utaaluu kan danda'u yoo ta'u, dorgommii fiigicha meetira dhibba keessatti nama kamiyyuu caalaa saffisaan fiiguu akka danda'u dhaabbatichi ibseera.

title: What to watch in Tuesday’s Florida primary elections
english: Florida voters are participating in primary elections this Tuesday, which serve as the first test for newly redrawn congressional districts designed to favor Republican candidates. A major focus is the crowded Republican race for governor, where Congressman Byron Donalds, backed by Donald Trump, is currently the frontrunner. These elections highlight Florida's significant shift toward the Republican party over the last decade, posing a major challenge for Democrats attempting to regain political influence in the state.
amharic: የፍሎሪዳ መራጮች ማክሰኞ በሚካሄደው የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ ላይ ድምፃቸውን እየሰጡ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ምርጫ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ተወዳዳሪዎች እንዲያደላ ተደርጎ የተቀየሰውን አዲስ የምርጫ ክልል ካርታ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሚፈትሽ ይሆናል። ትኩረቱ በዋናነት በሪፐብሊካን የገዥነት እጩዎች መካከል ባለው ውድድር ላይ ያተኮረ ሲሆን፣ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ድጋፍ የሚያገኙት ባይሮን ዶናልድስ ግንባር ቀደም ተወዳዳሪ ሆነው ቀርበዋል። ይህ ምርጫ ላለፉት አስርት ዓመታት ፍሎሪዳ ወደ ቀኝ ዘንበል ማለቷን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ለዴሞክራቶች በግዛቲቱ ያላቸውን የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ መልሰው ለማግኘት ፈታኝ ሆኗል።
oromo: Filattoonni Floridaa Kibxata har'a filannoo jalqabaa irratti hirmaachaa jiru; kunis kaartaa daangaa filannoo haaraa kanneen bakka bu'oota Rippabliikaaniif mijaatu ta'e qorachuuf carraa jalqabaati. Xiyyeeffannoon guddaan dorgommii guddaa gama bulchiinsa mootummaa naannichaa (governor) irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, kanaanis miseensi Kongireesii Bayron Doonaalds kan deggarsa Doonaald Traamp argatan dursee jira. Filannoon kun Floridaan waggoota kudhan darban keessa gara siyaasa mirgaatti gombisamuu ishee agarsiisa; kunis warra Dimookiraataaf dhiibbaa siyaasaa naannichaa deeffachuuf waan ulfaataa ta'eera.

title: Top Russian economist ousted after warning of growing costs of Ukraine war
english: Andrey Klepach, the chief economist at Russia's state-run bank VEB, has been dismissed after his critical remarks about the economic impact of the war in Ukraine became public. In a speech, he argued that Russia is falling behind technologically and economically, warning that the ongoing conflict is creating a long-term social and fiscal crisis. This rare critique from a senior government official highlights the growing internal strain caused by the war of attrition.
amharic: የሩሲያ የልማት ባንክ ዋና ኢኮኖሚስት የነበሩት አንድሬ ክሌፓች፣ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ምክንያት የሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ እየተዳከመ መሆኑን በይፋ በመተቸታቸው ከኃላፊነታቸው ተነስተዋል። ክሌፓች በንግግራቸው ሩሲያ በቴክኖሎጂ እና በኢኮኖሚ ከሌሎች አገራት ወደ ኋላ እየቀረች እንደሆነና ጦርነቱ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ከባድ ማህበራዊና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ እንደሚፈጥር አስጠንቅቀው ነበር። ይህ የመንግስት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን የሰጡት ትችት ጦርነቱ በሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ እየፈጠረ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጫና ያሳያል።
oromo: Gorsaan diinagdee olaanaa baankii mootummaa Raashiyaa (VEB) kan ta'an Andrey Klepach, waraanni Yukreenii diinagdee biyyattii irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jiraachuusaanii dubbachuusaanii hordofee hojiirraa ari'amaniiru. Klepach, Raashiyaan guddina teknooloojii fi diinagdeen biyyoota kaan irraa duubatti hafaa akka jirtu fi waraanni kun rakkoo hawaasummaa fi dinagdee cimaa fiduu danda'a jechuun akeekkachiisaniiru. Adeemsi kun, qeeqni akkanaa hoggansa olaanaa mootummaa keessaa dhufuunsaa miidhaa waraanni kun biyyattii irratti geessisaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: China censors public mourning as it holds former premier's funeral
english: China recently held a private funeral for former Premier Zhu Rongji, a key economic reformer who passed away at 97. While the government honored him as a loyal party member, authorities are actively censoring public expressions of grief and online tributes. This suppression reflects the state's fear that nostalgia for Zhu's era could transform into protests against the current administration.
amharic: ቻይና በቅርቡ በ97 አመታቸው ያረፉትን የቀድሞ የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዡ ሮንግጂን የቀብር ስነስርዓት በድብቅ አካሂዳለች። መንግስት የሟቹን ታማኝነት ቢገልጽም፣ የህዝብ ሀዘን መግለጫዎችን እና በኢንተርኔት የሚወጡ አድናቆቶችን በጽኑ እየተቆጣጠረ ይገኛል። ይህም የሟቹን ዘመን መናፈቅ በወቅታዊው መንግስት ላይ ወደ ተቃውሞ ሊቀየር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት እንዳላቸው ያሳያል።
oromo: Chaayinaan yeroo ammaa kana awwaalcha muummicha ministeeraa durii Zhu Rongjii, namoota biyyattii guddina dinagdee irratti gahee guddaa qaban keessaa tokko ta'anii fi umurii 97tti du'an raawwatteetti. Mootummaan akka miseensa dhaabaa amanamuutti isaan kabajus, miira gadduu fi yaada weebsaayitii irratti kennamu irratti hammaa'ina cimaa gochaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun yaadannoon bara isaanii kun gara mormii mootummaa ammaa irratti kan geessu ta'uu isaa mootummaan akka sodaatu agarsiisa.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current political climate in Tigray reflects historical patterns that previously led to Eritrea's independence. The government's National Dialogue is being criticized for excluding key armed and political factions, leading many to view it as an ineffective process rather than a genuine effort for peace. By failing to include Tigray in national elections or policy discussions, the state risks further alienating the region and repeating the governance failures of the past.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በትግራይ ክልል እየተከተለ ያለው አካሄድ ከዚህ ቀደም ኤርትራ ከኢትዮጵያ እንድትገነጠል ካደረጉት ታሪካዊ ስህተቶች ጋር ይመሳሰላል። በሀገራዊ ምክክር ሂደቱ ውስጥ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ እና የትጥቅ ቡድኖች አለመካተታቸው ሂደቱን እውነተኛ የሰላም ጥረት ከመሆን ይልቅ ውጤታማ ያልሆነ ስልት እንዲመስል አድርጎታል። ትግራይን ከምርጫ እና ከፖለቲካዊ ውይይቶች ውጭ በማድረግ፣ መንግስት የክልሉን ህዝብ የመገለል ስሜት እንዲጨምር እና ያለፉትን የፖለቲካ ስህተቶች የመድገም አደጋን እየጋበዘ ይገኛል።
oromo: Haalli siyaasaa Itoophiyaa amma naannoo Tigraayitti mul’atu, seenaa kanaan dura biyyattii irraa Eritrea addaan baasuuf sababa ta’e wajjin wal fakkaata. Mariin Biyyoolessaa mootummaan gaggeessaa jiru gareewwan siyaasaafi hidhattoota ijoo hirmaachisuu dhabuun isaa, mariin kun furmaata dhugaa osoo hin taane fakkeessaa ta’uu isaa baay’een dubbatu. Tigraay mariifi filannoo biyyoolessaa keessatti hirmaachisuu dhiisuun, mootummaan naannichaa ofirraa fageessuufi dogoggoroota seenaa darban irra deebi’uuf karaa saaqaa jira.

title: Israel’s siege on Gaza is creating a breast cancer crisis
english: The ongoing siege and conflict in Gaza have severely disrupted the healthcare system, leaving women with breast cancer unable to access timely diagnosis and essential treatment. Due to a critical shortage of medical equipment, such as mammography machines, and a lack of specialized care, patients are facing delayed interventions and worsening health outcomes. Health experts warn that this collapse in medical services is creating a dire crisis for thousands of women battling the disease.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነትና ማዕቀብ የጤና አገልግሎቱን በማናጋቱ የጡት ካንሰር ያለባቸው ሴቶች ምርመራና ህክምና ለማግኘት ተቸግረዋል። አስፈላጊ የህክምና መሳሪያዎች እጥረትና የባለሙያዎች እጥረት በታካሚዎች ላይ የጤና መጓተት አስከትሏል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ይህ የህክምና አገልግሎት መስተጓጎል በሺዎች ለሚቆጠሩ ሴቶች የካንሰር ህመም እጅግ አሳሳቢ ችግር ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Waraanniifi uggurri gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru sirna fayyaa miidhuun dubartoonni kaansarii harmaa qaban akka dafanii qorannoo fi wal'ansa argachuu hin dandeenye godheera. Meeshaalee yaalaa akka mammography fi tajaajila addaa dhabuun dhukkubsattootaaf rakkoo cimaa uumeera. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa akka ibsanitti, hir'inni tajaajila fayyaa kun dubartoota kaansariin qabaman kumaan lakkaa'amaniif balaa hamaa ta'e uumeera.

title: Canada battles the clock, politics in scramble to avert Trump’s tariffs
english: The Canadian government is urgently negotiating with the United States to prevent the implementation of 50-percent tariffs on various Canadian exports. President Trump plans to apply these duties to goods like electronics, machinery, and dairy products, claiming that Canada treats American products unfairly. If a deal is not reached quickly, these significant taxes will threaten numerous Canadian businesses by making their products too expensive for the American market.
amharic: የካናዳ መንግሥት በተለያዩ የካናዳ ምርቶች ላይ ሊጣል የታቀደውን የ50 በመቶ የታሪፍ ጭማሪ ለማስቀረት ከአሜሪካ ጋር በአስቸኳይ እየተደራደረ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የካናዳ መንግሥት ለአሜሪካ ምርቶች ፍትሃዊ ያልሆነ አያያዝ እያደረገ ነው በሚል በኤሌክትሮኒክስ፣ በማሽነሪዎች እና በወተት ተዋጽኦዎች ላይ ይህን ቀረጥ ለመጣል አቅደዋል። ስምምነት ካልተደረሰ፣ እነዚህ ከፍተኛ ታሪፎች የካናዳ ምርቶች በአሜሪካ ገበያ ላይ ተወዳዳሪ እንዳይሆኑ በማድረግ በብዙ የካናዳ ንግዶች ላይ ጉዳት ያደርሳሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Kaanaadaa gatii meeshaalee gara Ameerikaa ergiturraa dhibbeentaa 50 ol ka'uuf karoorfame ittisuuf Ameerikaa waliin marii ariifachiisaa gochaa jira. Pirezidaanti Traamp tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan, Kaanaadaan meeshaalee Ameerikaaf qajeelfama haqa qabeessa hin taane hordofaa jirti jedhanii waan amananif yoo ta'u, kunis meeshaalee elektirooniksii, maashinootaafi oomishaalee aannanii kan dabalatudha. Yoo mariin kun milkaa'uu baate, gibirri cimaan kun oomishoonni Kaanaadaa gabaa Ameerikaa keessatti gatiin isaanii akka dabaluufi dorgomaa akka hin taane gochuun, dhaabbilee daldalaa biyyattii hedduu miidhuu danda'a.

title: Russia says more than 600 drones targeted Moscow region
english: Russian authorities reported a massive drone assault involving over 600 aircraft targeting the Moscow region, marking one of the largest attacks since the conflict began. While many drones were intercepted, the debris caused injuries to three people and damaged residential homes and a logistics warehouse. This escalation in long-distance strikes comes as both Russia and Ukraine increase their use of drone warfare against infrastructure and civilian targets.
amharic: የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት ከ600 በላይ ድሮኖች የሞስኮን ክልል ኢላማ ያደረጉበት መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቀዋል። አብዛኞቹ ድሮኖች በሩሲያ የአየር መከላከያ ቢመቱም፣ የወደቁት የድሮን ስብርባሪዎች ሶስት ሰዎችን በማቁሰል የመኖሪያ ቤቶችንና የሎጂስቲክስ መጋዘኖችን አውድመዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ሁለቱም ሀገራት በጦርነቱ ውስጥ የረጅም ርቀት የድሮን ጥቃቶችን በእጅጉ በመጨመራቸው የተፈጠረ ነው፡፡
oromo: Hoggantoonni Raashiya akka ibsanitti, magaalota naannoo Moskow irratti xiyyara malee nam-deeman (drones) 600 ol fayyadamuun haleellaa guddaan raawwatameera. Xiyyaroonni kun hedduun isaanii ittisa qilleensaan kan kuffifaman ta'us, haphurriin isaanii namoota sadii miidhuu fi manneen jireenyaa akkasumas bakka kuusaa meeshaalee mancaasera. Haleellaan kun kan agarsiisu, biyyoonni lamaanuu walitti bu'iinsa kanaan walqabatee haleellaa fagootti xiyyeeffatuu fi fayyadama teeknoolojii diroonii dabalaa akka jiranidha.

title: Vessel hit by ‘unknown projectile’ in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
english: A commercial ship traveling through the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unidentified projectile, causing damage to its engine room and one crew member to suffer injuries. The Omani coastguard is currently assisting the crew, and authorities have launched an investigation into the attack. This incident occurred amidst heightened regional tensions and a recent lapse in agreements aimed at keeping the vital waterway open.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ሲጓዝ የነበረ የንግድ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመቶ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ጥቃቱ የመርከቧን ሞተር ክፍል ከመጉዳቱም በላይ አንድ የሰራተኛ አባል ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። የኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ጠባቂዎች ድጋፍ እየሰጡ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናትም በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው አካባቢው ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ባለበት እና የባህር መስመሩን ክፍት ለማድረግ የተደረጉ ስምምነቶች ጊዜያቸው ባበቃበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Dooniin daldalaa tokko karaa handhuura Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) darbuu isaa irratti miidhaan irra ga'eera. Miidhaan kun kutaa injiinii doonichaa kan miidhe yoo ta'u, hojjattoota keessaa namni tokko miidhamuun gabaasameera. Eegdonni qarqara galaana Omaan gargaarsa kennuuf iddoo sana qaqqabaniiru akkasumas qaamoleen dhimmi ilaalu qorannoo jalqabaniiru. Rakkoon kun kan uumame waraana naannichaa fi walii galtee daandii bishaanii kana banuuf ture dhumachuu hordofee dha.

title: Can China’s new Arctic Sea route to Europe replace Middle East chokepoints?
english: China has launched a new 'Ice Silk Road' shipping route through the Arctic Ocean to connect Asia and Europe more efficiently. This path significantly reduces travel time compared to traditional routes through the Suez Canal or around Africa, which are currently facing disruptions due to regional conflicts. While this offers a faster alternative for time-sensitive goods, analysts warn that it may create new geopolitical tensions, particularly with the United States.
amharic: ቻይና በሰሜን ዋልታ በኩል የሚያልፍ አዲስ የባህር ንግድ መስመር የሆነውን 'አይስ ሲልክ ሮድ' ይፋ አድርጋለች። ይህ መስመር በአሁኑ ወቅት በግጭቶች ሳቢያ ከተስተጓጎሉት እንደ ቀይ ባህር ካሉ ባህላዊ የመርከብ መስመሮች በበለጠ ፍጥነት እስያን እና አውሮፓን ያገናኛል። ይህ አዲስ የንግድ መስመር ፈጣን አገልግሎት ቢሰጥም፣ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በተለይም ከአሜሪካ ጋር የፖለቲካ ውጥረትን ሊቀሰቅስ እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Chaayinaan karaa galaana Arktik fayyadamuun daandiin daldalaa haaraan 'Ice Silk Road' jedhamu kan inni jalqabe ta'uun beekameera. Daandiin kun karaa aadaa kan akka Suez Canal ykn qarqara Afrikaa waraanaafi rakkoolee naannootti argamaniin gufatan caalaa saffisaan Eeshiyaafi Awurooppaa walitti qunnamsiisa. Daandiin kun meeshaalee saffisaan gahuu qabanif filannoo gaarii ta'us, dorgommii geopolitikii keessattuu kan Chaayinaafi Ameerikaa gidduu jiru daran hammaachisuu akka danda'u xiinxaltoonni ni ibsu.

title: Iran's Ghalibaf heads to Iraq on Wednesday for cooperation talks
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf is traveling to Iraq on Wednesday to meet with top government officials. The visit aims to improve strategic relations between the two nations by focusing on economic partnerships, regional security, and border cooperation. Both sides will also review the progress of existing agreements to strengthen their bilateral ties.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ከኢራቅ ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ጋር ለመወያየት ረቡዕ ዕለት ወደ ባግዳድ ያመራሉ። ጉብኝታቸው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ኢኮኖሚያዊ ትብብር፣ የድንበር ደህንነት እና ቀጠናዊ ግንኙነቶችን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። እንዲሁም ቀደም ሲል የተፈረሙ ስምምነቶች አፈፃፀም ላይ ይወያያሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iran Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf dhimmoota nageenyaa fi walta'iinsa dinagdee irratti mari'achuuf guyyaa Roobii gara Iraaq imalu. Daawwannaan kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii cimsuu fi waliigaltee kanaan dura mallatteeffaman hojiirra oolchuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba. Isaanis qondaaltota biyyattii olaanoo waliin ta'uun tasgabbii naannichaa irratti bal'inaan mari'atu.

title: Trump says N Korea’s Kim has responded to his request for a conversation
english: President Donald Trump claims that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has positively responded to his recent request for dialogue. Concurrently, Trump has ordered a reduction in joint military exercises with South Korea, criticizing Seoul for not supporting U.S. military operations against Iran. Despite these tensions, South Korean officials maintain that their defensive drills are peaceful and aim to ensure regional security.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ለውይይት ላቀረቡት ጥያቄ አዎንታዊ ምላሽ እንደሰጡ ተናግረዋል። በተመሳሳይ ትራምፕ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር የሚደረጉ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን እንዲቀንሱ ያዘዙ ሲሆን፣ ሴኡል በአሜሪካ የኢራን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ላይ ባለመተባበሯም ተችተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ አለመግባባት ቢኖርም የደቡብ ኮሪያ ባለስልጣናት ወታደራዊ ልምምዶቹ ሰላማዊ እና የክልሉን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ የታለሙ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp dura ta'aan Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Joong Un marii isaan gaafatanirratti deebii gaarii kennuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, Traamp waltajjii leenjii waraanaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa wajjin taasisan akka hir'isu ajajanii, mootummaan Se'ool duula waraanaa Ameerikaan Iraan irratti gaggeessitu deeggaruu diduu ishee ceepha'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun jiraatus, qondaalonni Kooriyaa Kibbaa leenjiin waraanaa kun nagaa qabaachuu fi nageenya naannichaa eeguuf kan qophaa'e ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Kushner says Israel can 'finish the job properly' in Gaza if Hamas disagrees to disarm
english: US envoy Jared Kushner stated that Israel maintains American backing to finalize its military objectives in Gaza if Hamas refuses to lay down its arms. Kushner emphasized that the rebuilding of Gaza is contingent upon the group's disarmament and adherence to Trump's peace initiative. Despite these efforts, he affirmed that Israel retains its absolute right to take defensive actions against any immediate threats.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር ሃማስ ትጥቅ ካልፈታ እስራኤል በጋዛ ወታደራዊ ዓላማዋን ለማሳካት የአሜሪካ ድጋፍ እንዳላት አስታውቀዋል። የጋዛ መልሶ ግንባታ የሚከናወነው ሃማስ ትጥቁን ሲፈታ እና የትራምፕን የሰላም እቅድ ሲቀበል ብቻ እንደሆነም ገልጸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ሰላማዊ መፍትሄዎች ቢኖሩም እስራኤል የራሷን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ የምታደርገውን ማንኛውንም እርምጃ የመውሰድ መብት እንደተጠበቀ ነው።
oromo: Ergamtooni Ameerikaa Jared Kushner akka jedhanitti, Hamas hidhannoo hiikuu yoo dide Israa'el gaaza keessatti galma waraana ishee guutuuf deeggarsa Ameerikaa akka qabdu ibsaniiru. Guddina gaazaa deebisanii ijaaruufi akkaataa karoorri nagaa Trump itti raawwatamu hamma Hamas hidhannoo hiikutti kan hin eegalle ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kana hundumaa wajjiin, Israa'el balaa ishee mudachuu danda'u kamirraayyuu of ittisuuf mirga guutuu akka qabdu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Morning update
english: A ship was damaged by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing crew injuries and prompting warnings from Iran against vessels supporting US military operations. Meanwhile, tensions persist in Gaza as Israel continues targeted strikes despite US pushback, and airstrikes have hit a military airport in northern Syria. Additionally, Iranian officials condemned an attack on Iraq's Kurdish regional leadership, while Turkey urged the US to prioritize de-escalation with Tehran.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ አንድ መርከብ ባልታወቀ ጥቃት ተጎድቶ የሰራተኞች ጉዳት ደርሷል፤ ኢራንም የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚደግፉ መርከቦች ላይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስጠንቅቃለች። በሌላ በኩል በእስራኤል እና ጋዛ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ በሰሜናዊ ሶሪያ የሚገኝ ወታደራዊ አየር ማረፊያም በድብደባ ተመቷል። ከዚህም ባሻገር ኢራን በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት ያወገዘች ሲሆን፣ ቱርክ ደግሞ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ያላትን ውጥረት በሰላማዊ መንገድ እንድትፈታ ጥሪ አቅርባለች።
oromo: Hormuzitti markabni tokko miidhamee namootni irratti midhaan ga'eera; Iraanis hojii waraana Ameerikaa deggeran irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatu akeekkachiisteetti. Gama biraatiin, Israa'el fi Gaaza gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi itti fufee kan jiru yoo ta'u, buufanni xiyyaaraa waraanaas Kaaba Sooriyaatti haleelameera. Kana malees, Iraan haleellaa naannoo Kurdistaan Iraaqitti raawwatame balaaleffatteetti; akkasumas Turkeen, Ameerikaan Iraan waliin jireenya tasgabbaa'aa akka uumtu gaafatteetti.

title: Can Trump limit birthright citizenship? Legal experts are doubtful
english: Legal experts are skeptical that former President Trump can successfully restrict birthright citizenship through executive orders. Similar previous attempts have faced significant challenges, and analysts believe any new effort would likely be struck down by the courts. Consequently, experts suggest that such a move is legally unlikely to succeed under existing constitutional standards.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በስልጣን ዘመናቸው የነበራቸውን የዜግነት መብት በስራ አስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዝ ለመገደብ ያደረጉት ሙከራ የህግ ባለሙያዎችን ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ተመሳሳይ ሙከራዎች በፍርድ ቤት ውድቅ የተደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ማንኛውም አዲስ ተመሳሳይ እርምጃም ተመሳሳይ እጣ ፋንታ እንደሚገጥመው ባለሙያዎች ያምናሉ። ስለዚህም እንዲህ ያለው ሀሳብ በህገ-መንግስቱ መሰረት ስኬታማ የመሆን ዕድሉ በጣም ዝቅተኛ እንደሆነ ይነገራል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Traamp mirga lammiin dhalootaan argatu ajaja qaama raawwachiiftuun daangessuuf yaalii godhan irratti ogeeyyiin seeraa shakkii qabu. Yaaliiwwan kanaan dura godhaman seeraan kan mormaman turan, kanaafis yaalii haarawa kamiyyuu mana murtii biratti fudhatama akka hin arganne ogeeyyiin ni hubatu. Kanaafuu, tarkiiniin kun seera bu'uuraa biyyattii wajjin kan wal-hin simanne waan ta'eef, milkaa'uun isaa akka hin oolle ibsameera.

title: IVF staff accused of misleading UK parents about sperm and egg donors in northern Cyprus
english: At least 30 children, mostly from the UK, may have been conceived using the wrong sperm or egg donors at fertility clinics in northern Cyprus. Parents allege they were misled by staff at the Dogus IVF Centre regarding the identity and background of the donors they specifically selected. Local authorities have launched an investigation into these concerns, as the clinic faced previous warnings and has been blacklisted by a major international sperm bank.
amharic: ቢያንስ 30 የሚሆኑ ህጻናት፣ አብዛኛዎቹ የብሪታንያ ተወላጆች፣ በሰሜን ሳይፕረስ በሚገኙ የወሊድ ህክምና ማዕከላት የተሳሳተ የወንድ ዘር ወይም የእንቁላል ለጋሾችን በመጠቀም የተፀነሱ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ተጠቁሟል። ወላጆች በዶጉስ አይቪኤፍ ማዕከል የሚሰሩ ሰራተኞች በመረጧቸው ለጋሾች ማንነት ላይ ስህተት እንደፈጸሙባቸው ይከሳሉ። ጉዳዩ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እየተደረገበት ሲሆን፣ ክሊኒኩ ከዚህ ቀደም በአለም አቀፍ የዘር ባንክ ጥቁር መዝገብ ውስጥ መግባቱ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Ijoolleen 30 ta’an kanneen irra caalaan isaanii biyya UK irraa dhufan, Kilinikoota fayyaa biyya Saayippires kaabaa keessatti sanyiin dhiiraa ykn kooqqoon (egg) sirriin alatti akka fayyadaman shakkameera. Warri ijoollee kanaa, hoggantoonni kilinika Dogus IVF fedhii isaanii eeganii osoo hin taane, namoota biroo fayyadamuun gowwoomsuu isaanii himatu. Dhimmi kun mootummaa naannichaan qoratamaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, kilinikiin Dogus kun kanaan dura dhaabbata sanyii dhiiraa guddaa addunyaatiin harka garaagaree (blacklist) godhamee ture.

title: Inside secret police warehouse as Germany targets small boats gangs
english: German authorities have conducted their first raids under a new law designed to disrupt criminal gangs supplying equipment for illegal small boat crossings to the UK. Police seized thousands of life jackets and numerous inflatable dinghies from a storage facility, which could have facilitated the transport of over 2,000 migrants. This operation represents a significant shift in legal strategy, as Germany now specifically targets the facilitation of migrant smuggling to countries outside the European Union.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት ወደ እንግሊዝ በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ በትንንሽ ጀልባዎች የሚደረጉ ጉዞዎችን የሚያመቻቹ የወንጀል ቡድኖችን ለመቆጣጠር በወጣ አዲስ ህግ መሰረት የመጀመሪያውን ዘመቻ አካሂደዋል። ፖሊስ ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ ስደተኞችን ማጓጓዝ የሚችሉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የህይወት አድን ጃኬቶችን እና በርካታ ጀልባዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ይህ እርምጃ ጀርመን ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ውጭ ለሆኑ ሀገራት የሚደረግ ህገ-ወጥ ስደትን በልዩ ህግ ለመቅጣት ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Jarmanii gareewwan yakkaa doonii xixiqqoodhaan gara biyya Ingilizitti godaantota seeraan alaa dabarsan to'achuuf seera haaraa baaseen tarkaanfii jalqabaa fudhataniiru. Poolisiin kurnee fi meeshaalee qaxxaamuraa hanga kuma lamaa ol ta'an kan of keessatti qabatan meeshaalee badiisaa fi uffata lubbuu baraaruu hedduu to'annoo jala oolcheera. Tarkaanfiin kun Jarmaniin biyyoota gamtaa Awurooppaa alatti godaantota seeraan alaa dabarsuu irratti seera cimaa hojiirra oolchuu kan jalqabde ta'uu argisiisa.

title: A hero’s welcome as Cameroon parades its first Women’s AFCON title
english: The Cameroon women's national football team returned home to a celebratory reception in Yaounde after winning their first-ever Women’s Africa Cup of Nations championship. The team, known as the Indomitable Lionesses, defeated Malawi 3-0 in the tournament final. This significant victory also officially earned them a spot in next year’s Women’s World Cup.
amharic: የካሜሮን የሴቶች ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን ታሪካዊውን የመጀመሪያ የአፍሪካ ሴቶች ዋንጫ ካሸነፈ በኋላ በያውንዴ ደማቅ አቀባበል ተደረገለት። ኢንዶሚተብል ላይነስ በመባል የሚታወቁት ተጫዋቾቹ፣ የፍጻሜውን ጨዋታ ማላዊን 3-0 በማሸነፍ ዋንጫውን ማንሳት ችለዋል። ቡድኑ በዚህ ድል አማካኝነት በሚቀጥለው ዓመት ለሚካሄደው የሴቶች የዓለም ዋንጫ ተሳትፎውን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Garee kubbaa miillaa dubartoota Kaameeroon injifannoo waancaa Afrikaa isa jalqabaa erga galmeessisanii booda magaalaa Yaawundee keessatti simannaa hoo'aa argataniiru. Gareen Indomitable Lionesses jedhamu kun tapha xumuraa irratti Maalaawwii 3-0 injifachuudhaan waancicha fudhachuu danda'eera. Injifannoo kanaanis gareen kun dorgommii waancaa addunyaa dubartootaa kan waggaa dhufu gaggeeffamuuf darbeera.

title: US lawmaker calls for action against settler violence in the West Bank
english: US House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has urged the Trump administration to push Israel to stop the surge in settler violence within the West Bank. Reports indicate that these attacks have killed 18 people, injured hundreds, and displaced thousands of Palestinians so far in 2026. Jeffries emphasized that the Israeli government must be held accountable for protecting the safety and property of innocent civilians.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አናሳ ብሄረሰብ መሪ ሀኪም ጄፍሪስ፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በእስራኤል ተቀማጭ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸመውን ጥቃት እንዲያስቆም ግፊት እንዲያደርግ ጠይቀዋል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2026 ብቻ በእነዚህ ጥቃቶች ምክንያት 18 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ፣ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቆስለዋል እንዲሁም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተፈናቅለዋል። ጄፍሪስ እንዳሉት የእስራኤል መንግስት የፍልስጤማውያንን ህይወት እና ንብረት የመጠበቅ ህጋዊ ኃላፊነት አለበት።
oromo: Mummichi garee xiqqaa mana maree bakka buutota Ameerikaa Hakeem Jeffries, mootummaan Traamp haleellaa qe'ee qabattonni Israa'el naannoo Daangaa Dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti raawwachaa jiran dhaabsisuuf Israa'el irratti dhiibbaa akka godhu gaafataniiru. Bara 2026 qofatti haleellaa kanaan namoonni 18 yoo du'an, dhibboonni miidhaniiru akkasumas kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Jeffries akka ibsanitti, mootummaan Israa'el jireenyaa fi qabeenya namoota nagaa eeguuf dirqama qaba.

title: US Democrats set to push for resolutions to stomp out Trump's war powers
english: Democratic lawmakers in the U.S. Congress are planning to introduce resolutions to curb President Donald Trump's authority to initiate military action. This move follows the President's aggressive rhetoric directed toward Oman, a key American ally. Legislators like Tim Kaine argue that these threats undermine U.S. interests and intend to prevent the administration from entering unnecessary conflicts.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ ዴሞክራቶች ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ያለ ፍቃድ ጦርነት የመክፈት ስልጣናቸውን የሚገድብ አዲስ ውሳኔ ለማስተላለፍ እየተዘጋጁ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ፕሬዝዳንቱ ከአሜሪካ የቅርብ አጋር ከሆነችው ኦማን ጋር በተያያዘ የዛቻ ንግግር ከተናገሩ በኋላ ነው። እንደ ቲም ኬይን ያሉ የህግ አውጭዎች እንደዚህ አይነት ንግግሮች የአሜሪካን ጥቅም እንደሚጎዱ በመግለጽ፣ አላስፈላጊ ጦርነቶችን ለመከላከል እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Miseensonni paartii Demokiraatotaa kan Yunaayitid Isteets, aangoo Pireezidaant Donaald Tiraamp kan waraana labsuu daangessuuf murtoo haaraa qopheessaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, pireezidaantichi biyya michuu Ameerikaa taate Omaaniin sodaachisuu isaanii hordofee dha. Akka miseensa koongirasii Tiim Keeyin jedhutti, gochi akkasii kun faayidaa Ameerikaa kan miidhu fi waraana barbaachisu tokko malee ka'u ittisuuf kan yaadame dha.

title: Israeli forces carry out artillery shelling, strikes in south Lebanon
english: The Israeli military conducted a series of artillery attacks and airstrikes across several towns in southern Lebanon on Tuesday. The operations specifically targeted areas including Majdal Zoun, Mansouri, Haddatha, and Baraachit. These actions were reported by Lebanese state media amid ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ማክሰኞ ዕለት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ ተከታታይ የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ እና የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ጥቃቶቹ ማጅዳል ዘውን፣ ማንሱሪን፣ ሃዳታን እና ባራቺትን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። ይህንን መረጃ የሊባኖስ የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ክስተቱ በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el guyyaa Kibxata darbe kibba Libaanoos keessatti magaalonni garaagaraa irra haleellaa gumbii fi xiyyaaraan haleellee jira. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan akka Majdal Zoun, Mansouri, Haddatha fi Baraachit irratti xiyyeeffatee raawwatameera. Odeeffannoon kun miidiyaa mootummaa Libaanoos irraa kan argame yoo ta'u, kunis naannichatti waraanni akka hin hammaanne akeekkachiisa.

title: Four strikes hit military airport in Syria’s Idlib: Report
english: Four aerial strikes recently targeted the Abu al-Zuhour military airport located in Idlib, northern Syria. This event is notable as it is the first recorded military attack on the facility since the collapse of the al-Assad government last December. Authorities are monitoring the situation following this significant escalation in the region.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ሶሪያ ኢድሊብ ግዛት በሚገኘው አቡ አል-ዙሁር ወታደራዊ አየር ማረፊያ ላይ አራት የአየር ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የአል-አሳድ መንግስት በታህሳስ 2024 ከወደቀ በኋላ በአየር ማረፊያው ላይ ሲደርስ የመጀመሪያው ነው። ክስተቱ በክልሉ የተፈጠረውን አዲስ የጸጥታ መደፍረስ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Siriyaa kaabaatti, naannoo Idlibitti kan argamu buufata xiyyaaraa waraanaa Abu al-Zuhuur irratti haleellaan xiyyaaraa afur raawwatameera. Haleellaan kun mootummaan al-Assad mudde 2024 erga kufee asitti buufata kanatti yeroo jalqabaaf kan raawwatamedha. Haalli kun naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuu haaraa kan agarsiisu ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Damage, crew casualty reported onboard vessel hit in Hormuz Strait, UKMTO says
english: A ship traveling through the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unidentified projectile on Tuesday, causing engine room damage and injuries to the crew. The Omani Coast Guard is currently providing support and assistance to the remaining sailors on board. Authorities are investigating the incident following reports from maritime security officials.
amharic: ማክሰኞ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ ሲጓዝ የነበረ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር በመመታቱ የሞተር ክፍሉ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል፣ የሰው ህይወትም አልፏል። የኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ጠባቂዎች በቦታው በመገኘት ለቀሩት የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ነው። የብሪታንያ የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽንስ ስለ ጉዳዩ ምርመራ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kibxata darbe doonii tokko qaxxaamura Hormuz irra osoo deemtuu miidhaan irra gaheera. Miidhaan kun makiinaa doonichaa kan miidhe yoo ta'u, lubbuun namootas darbeera. Eegdonni qarqara galaana Omaan harka gargaarsaa kennuudhaan maatii doonichaa gargaaraa jiru.

title: Yemen’s armed forces say 133 operations carried out against Houthis
english: Yemen's military forces recently conducted 133 separate strikes against Houthi targets within a 24-hour period. These operations utilized a combination of drones, rockets, and field artillery to neutralize threats along the front lines. Army units stationed across various battle zones participated in this coordinated military campaign.
amharic: የየመን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ በሁቲዎች ላይ 133 የጥቃት እርምጃዎችን መውሰዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቶቹ ድሮኖችን፣ ሮኬቶችን እና የመድፍ ተኩስ በመጠቀም በግንባር ቀደም ቦታዎች ላይ የሚገኙ የሁቲ ስጋቶችን ለማምከን ያለሙ ናቸው። በተለያዩ የጦር ቀጠናዎች የተሰማሩ የጦር ክፍሎችም በዚህ የተቀናጀ ዘመቻ ተሳትፈዋል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Yaman sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti bakkeewwan Hutiin itti argaman irratti duula waraanaa 133 gaggeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Duulli kun xiyyaara malee fe'aman, rokeetii fi madafii fayyadamuun iddoo diinni itti hidhatee jiru irratti xiyyeeffateera. Humnoonni waraanaa gargaaraa adda waraanaa irratti argaman duula kana keessatti hirmaataniiru.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's democratic progress is hindered by a deeply rooted social culture that equates blind obedience with respect and questioning with disloyalty. This hierarchical mindset begins in the home, where children are conditioned to prioritize submission over critical thinking to ensure their own security. These patterns are reinforced in schools and workplaces, ultimately creating a society where challenging authority is risky and democratic engagement is stifled.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዲሞክራሲ ጉዞ ሥር የሰደደ እና ታዛዥነትን እንደ አክብሮት፣ ጥያቄን ደግሞ እንደ ክህደት በሚመለከት ማህበራዊ አስተሳሰብ የተገደበ ነው። ይህ ተዋረድ ላይ የተመሰረተ አስተሳሰብ በቤተሰብ ውስጥ ተጀምሮ ህጻናት ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ እንዲታዘዙ እና ሂሳዊ አስተሳሰባቸውን እንዲገድቡ ይገፋፋቸዋል። እነዚህ የአስተዳደግ ስልቶች በትምህርት ቤቶችና በስራ ቦታዎች በመቀጠላቸው፣ ስልጣንን መሞገት አደገኛ ወደሚሆንበት እና የዲሞክራሲ እሴቶች ወደሚዳከሙበት ሁኔታ ይመራሉ።
oromo: Deemmi dimookiraasii Itoophiyaa aadaa hawaasummaa gad-fageenyaan hidda godhate, isa ajajamuu fi kabaja wal qixxeessee, mormii immoo akka gantuutti ilaaluun danqameera. Yaadni caasaa ol-aantummaa irratti xiyyeeffatu kun maatii keessatti jalqabee, ijoolleen tasgabbii isaanii eeggachuuf jecha yaada ofii qabuun osoo hin taane ajajamuu akka dursan taasisama. Amalli kun manneen barnootaa fi bakka hojii keessatti cimsuun, namni aangoo qabu mormuun akka sodaachisaatti ilaalamee akka dimookiraasiin hin dagaagne taasisa.

title: Hichilema wins second second term as president of copper-rich Zambia
english: Hakainde Hichilema has secured a second term as the president of Zambia after capturing 60 percent of the total votes. The election process experienced minor delays due to violence directed at poll workers. Zambia remains a critical global player due to its significant copper production, which is highly sought after by major powers like China and the United States.
amharic: ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ በ60 በመቶ ድምጽ በማሸነፍ በዛምቢያ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ በፕሬዝዳንትነት ተመርጠዋል። የምርጫ ሂደቱ በምርጫ አስፈፃሚዎች ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት ምክንያት ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ተቋርጦ ነበር። ዛምቢያ ለዓለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ሽግግር ወሳኝ የሆነውን የመዳብ ማዕድን በማምረት ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ያላት ሀገር በመሆኗ፣ በቻይና እና በአሜሪካ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ይታይባታል።
oromo: Hakaayinde Hichileemaa sagalee guutuu irraa dhibbeentaa 60 argachuun pirezidaantii Zaambiyaa ta'anii filannoo lammaffaadhaaf filatamaniru. Adeemsi filannichaa hojjettoota filannoo irratti miidhaan waan gaheef yeroo gabaabaaf adda cite ture. Zaambiyaan oomisha koopparii idil-addunyaaf barbaachisaa ta'e irratti qooda olaanaa waan qabduuf, biyyoonni gurguddoon akka Chaayinaa fi Ameerikaan dorgommii cimaa irratti gochaa jiru.

title: Thousands mourn Jason Arday in London, blaming ‘racist’ press for his death
english: Thousands of mourners gathered in London to honor Jason Arday, the former Cambridge professor who passed away at age 41 following his resignation. Attendees held a vigil to express their grief and condemn the intense, racially charged media pressure surrounding plagiarism allegations that he had consistently denied. The community is calling for an end to what they describe as a harmful and racist campaign by the press that ultimately contributed to his untimely death.
amharic: በለንደን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በ41 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩትን የቀድሞ የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር ጄሰን አርዳይን ለማሰብ ተሰብስበው ነበር። ተሳታፊዎቹ በፕሮፌሰሩ ላይ የደረሰውን ያልተረጋገጠ የፕላጅያሪዝም ውንጀላ እና የሚዲያ ጫና በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ዘረኝነት የተጠናወተው የሚዲያ ዘገባ ለሞታቸው ምክንያት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ህዝቡ በተለይም አርዳይን ያጠቁ የሚዲያ አካላትን በመቃወም ለፍትህ እና ለክብር ድምፃቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman Londonitti, qorataa fi barsiisaa duraanii yuunivarsiitii Kaambiriij kan ta'an Jeeson Ardaay kan umriin isaanii 41 ta'e yaadachuuf walgahaniiru. Namoonni walgahii kana irratti argaman, himannaa 'plagiarism' ykn gosa-barruu hatuu jedhuun miidiyaaleen itti fayyadamuun isaan miidhuu fi dhiibbaa sanyummaan guutame irra gahuu isaa balaaleeffataniiru. Hawaasni, gabaasni miidiyaa walitti fufiinsa qabu kun jireenya isaanii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee lubbuu isaanii dabarsuun isaa gadda guddaa uumeera jedhu.

title: Tupac murder trial: 'All hell broke loose' night of rapper's shooting, witness says
english: The murder trial for legendary rapper Tupac Shakur has officially begun in Las Vegas, with prosecutors accusing former gang leader Duane 'Keffe D' Davis of orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting. While the prosecution claims Davis planned the attack as an act of retaliation, the defense argues that the case is based on a fabricated narrative and lacks concrete evidence. The trial seeks to finally resolve the decades-old mystery surrounding Shakur's death, which has long been linked to the intense hip-hop rivalries of the 1990s.
amharic: የታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር የነፍስ ማጥፋት ክስ ክርክር በላስ ቬጋስ ተጀምሯል። አቃቤ ህግ የቀድሞ የጋንግ መሪ የሆኑት ድዌን 'ኬፌ ዲ' ዴቪስ በ1996 የተፈጸመውን የቦዘኑ ጥቃት ያቀናበሩት እሳቸው ናቸው ሲል ይከሳል። የተከላካይ ጠበቆች በበኩላቸው ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ እና ማስረጃ የሌለው መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ክስ ለብዙ አስርት ዓመታት ያልተፈታውን የቱፓክ ሻኩርን ሞት ምስጢር ለማጣራት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ajjeechaa raappera beekamaa Tuupaak Shaakuur ilaalchisee mormiin seeraa magaalaa Laas Veegasitti eegalameera. Abbaan alangaa hogganaa garee badii duraanii Dueen 'Keef D' Deevis dhukaasa bara 1996 raawwatame sana akka qindeessan himatu. Gareen ittisaa gama isaaniitiin himannaan kun kan hin dhugoofneefi ragaa qabatamaa kan hin qabne ta'uu dubbatu. Seera qabeessummaan kun ajjeechaa Tuupaak Shaakuur kan waggoota soddoma darbanii as furmaata akka argatuuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Two killed as gunman opens fire at Philippines high school, official says
english: A tragic shooting occurred at a high school in Zamboanga, Philippines, resulting in the deaths of two individuals. Local authorities confirmed that both victims were students, with one of them identified as the shooter. Police have secured the campus while investigations into the incident continue.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ ዛምቦአንጋ ከተማ በሚገኝ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጠረ የተኩስ አደጋ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የከተማዋ አስተዳዳሪዎች እንደገለፁት ሁለቱም የሞቱት ተማሪዎች ሲሆኑ፣ ከእነዚህ ውስጥ አንዱ ተኳሹ ራሱ ነው። የፖሊስ ሰራዊት የትምህርት ቤቱን ግቢ ደህንነት የተቆጣጠረ ሲሆን ምርመራውም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Magaalaa Zaambo-aangaa kan Filippinsii keessatti mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa tokko keessatti dhukaasa banameen lubbuun namoota lamaa darbeera. Abbootiin taayitaa akka ibsanitti, namoonni lamaan du'an barattoota yoo ta'an, isaan keessaa tokko kan dhukaasa bane sana akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera. Poolisiin nagaa mana barumsaa sanaa eegsisuu fi qorannoo geggeessuu itti fufeera.

title: Trump says talking to North Korea’s Kim makes the south safer
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un reacted favorably to a proposal for diplomatic discussions. To support these talks and improve regional security, Trump decided to reduce military training exercises with South Korea. He maintains that direct communication with the North Korean leader is a key step toward ensuring safety in the area.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ለድርድር የቀረበላቸውን ጥያቄ በአዎንታዊ መልኩ እንደተቀበሉት ገልጸዋል። የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ሲባል ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር ይካሄዱ የነበሩ የጦር ልምምዶችን ለመቀነስ ወስነዋል። ከሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ጋር ቀጥተኛ ውይይት ማድረግ ለቀጠናው ሰላም ወሳኝ እንደሆነም አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp, hogganaan Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Joong Un gaaffii marii isaan dhiheessaniif deebii gaarii kennuu isaa ibsaniiru. Nageenya naannichaa eeguuf jecha, Tiraamp leenjii waraanaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa wajjin taasisan hir’isuuf murteessaniiru. Hojiin marii hogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa wajjin godhamu nageenya naannichaaf murteessaa akka ta’e himaniiru.

title: Large fire breaks out at fuel depot near Iraq’s Sulaimaniyah
english: A massive fire erupted at a fuel storage facility in the Tanjaro area near Sulaimaniyah, Iraq, causing significant destruction to dozens of tankers and millions of liters of fuel. While the blaze triggered several explosions and injured approximately 20 people, officials confirmed that all injuries were minor and no fatalities occurred. Authorities have since brought the fire under control, and experts do not anticipate a spike in local fuel prices as a result of the incident.
amharic: በኢራቅ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል በምትገኘው ሱለይማኒያ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የነዳጅ ማከማቻ ጣቢያ ላይ ከፍተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። አደጋው በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ የነዳጅ ተሽከርካሪዎችን እና በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሊትር ነዳጅ ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ ወደ 20 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችም ቀላል ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱን ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠር መቻላቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በዚህ አደጋ ምክንያት በክልሉ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ላይ ለውጥ አይኖርም ብለው ይጠብቃሉ።
oromo: Irak, magaalaa Sulaayimaaniyaa biratti iddoo qulqulleeffannaa fi kuusaa boba'aa guddaa tokkotti ibidda hamaa ka'een miidhaan guddaan ga'eera. Ibidni kun konkolaattota boba'aa baatan hedduu fi boba'aa miliyoona sadii ol ta'u kan barbadeesse yoo ta'u, namoonni 20 ta'an miidhamaniiru; garuu miidhaan isaanii salphaa akka ta'e ibsameera. Qondaalonni akka himanitti, ibidda kana to'achuun danda'ameera akkasumas rakkoo kanaan walqabatee gatiin boba'aa naannichaa akka hin daballee abdatameera.

title: Russia warns UK over supplying drones to Ukraine
english: Russia has threatened the UK with consequences after British drones were used in Ukrainian attacks on Russian military and industrial sites. The Russian government accused Britain of directly participating in the conflict by supplying these weapons. In response, the UK Ministry of Defence stated that it remains committed to helping Ukraine defend itself against Russia's ongoing invasion.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ ድሮኖች በሩሲያ ወታደራዊ እና ኢንዱስትሪ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር ጥቅም ላይ ከዋሉ በኋላ ሩሲያ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ላይ የቅጣት እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች። የሩሲያ መንግሥት እነዚህን የጦር መሳሪያዎች በማቅረብ እንግሊዝ በቀጥታ በግጭቱ እየተሳተፈች ነው ሲል ከሷል። በምላሹም የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ዩክሬን እራሷን ከሩሲያ ወረራ እንድትከላከል ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ቁርጠኛ መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Rusiyan xiyyaarota nama malee (drones) kan Biriiteenii Itoophiyaa keessatti bakkeewwan waraanaa fi industirii Raashiyaarratti haleellaa raawwachuuf gargaaran booda, Biriiteenirratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka dandeessu akeekkachiisteetti. Mootummaan Raashiyaa, Biriiteen meeshaalee kanneen dhiyeessuun waraana kana keessatti kallattiidhaan hirmaachaa jirti jechuun himateera. Gama biraatiin, Ministeerri Ittisa Biriiteen, Yukreeniin weerara Raashiyaarraa of ittisuuf deeggarsa gochuu irratti cimtee kan itti fuftu ta'uu ibseera.

title: BBC breaks down Trump's latest shift on North and South Korea
english: President Donald Trump announced a significant decrease in joint military drills between the United States and South Korea. He attributed this decision to his positive rapport with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The move also follows Trump's dissatisfaction with the South Korean government's refusal to support the U.S. position on Iran's denuclearization.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በደቡብ ኮሪያ መካከል የሚደረጉ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀንሱ አስታውቀዋል። ይህን ውሳኔ የወሰዱት ከሰሜን ኮሪያ መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ባላቸው ጥሩ ግንኙነት ምክንያት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ውሳኔው የመጣው ደቡብ ኮሪያ በአሜሪካ የኢራን የኒውክሌር መርሃ ግብር ላይ አቋሟን ለመደገፍ ፈቃደኛ ባለመሆኗ ትራምፕ መበሳጨታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Traamp waltajjii waraanaa gamtaa Ameerikaa fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa gidduutti godhamu akka gad-xiqqaatu murteessaniiru. Murteen kun kan fudhatame hariiroo gaarii isaan hogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Joong Un wajjin qabanirratti hundaa'uudhaan akka ta'e ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe, mootummaan Kooriyaa Kibbaa dhimma niwukilaaraa Iraan irratti gorsa Ameerikaa fudhachuu diduu isaa hordofee aarii Traamp ka'e boodadha.

title: Norway's king admitted to hospital and put on sick leave
english: Norway's King Harald V has been hospitalized for treatment related to fluid retention and will take a two-week sick leave. During this time, Crown Prince Haakon will assume his royal responsibilities. The 89-year-old monarch has faced several health challenges recently but remains committed to his role without plans to abdicate.
amharic: የኖርዌዩ ንጉሥ ሃራልድ አምስተኛ በሰውነታቸው ውስጥ ፈሳሽ በመከማቸቱ ምክንያት ሆስፒታል የገቡ ሲሆን ለሁለት ሳምንታት ከሥራ እንዲታቀቡ ተወስኗል። በዚህ ጊዜ ውስጥ አልጋ ወራሹ ልዑል ሃኮን የንጉሣዊ ተግባራትን እንዲያከናውኑ ተመድበዋል። የ89 ዓመቱ ንጉሥ በቅርቡ የተለያዩ የጤና እክሎች ቢገጥሟቸውም፣ ከዙፋናቸው ለመውረድ ምንም ዕቅድ የላቸውም።
oromo: Mootichi biyya Noorway Haaraald 5ffaan dhukkuba dhangala'aan qaama keessatti kuufamuu isaatiin walqabatee hospitaala kan galan yoo ta'u, torban lamaaf boqonnaa fudhataniiru. Yeroo kana keessatti ilmi isaanii hangafni, Luleen Haakon, hojii mootummaa akka gaggeessan ta'eera. Mootichi umriin isaanii 89 kun dhiheenya kana rakkoolee fayyaa garagaraa keessa darbus, aangoo gadhiisuuf karoora tokkollee hin qaban.

title: Vigil held in central London for late Cambridge professor Jason Arday
english: A large crowd gathered at Trafalgar Square in London to mourn the death of Cambridge professor Jason Arday. During the vigil, speakers criticized the media for conducting a harsh campaign against him, linking his passing to issues of racism. Protesters are now demanding a formal public investigation into how he was treated.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩትን የጄሰን አርዳይን ህልፈት ለመዘከር በለንደን ትራፋልጋር አደባባይ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያለው ህዝብ ተሰብስቧል። በስነስርዓቱ ላይ የተናገሩት ሰዎች ሚዲያው በፕሮፌሰሩ ላይ ያደረሰውን አሉታዊ ዘመቻ በማውገዝ የሞታቸው ምክንያት ከዘረኝነት ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በጉዳዩ ላይም አፋጣኝ የሆነ የህዝብ ምርመራ እንዲካሄድ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Namoonni hedduun ta'e magaalaa Landan iddoo Tarafalgaar Iskuweeritti walitti qabamuun du'a piroofeesara Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirij kan ta'an Jeeson Arday kabajanii oolaniiru. Sagantaa kana irratti dubbattoonni, miidiyaaleen piroofeesaricha irratti duula hamaa geggeessaa turuu isaanii fi du'a isaa kana wajjin walqabatee rakkoon sanyi-jibbiinsaa jiraachuu isaanii kaasuun komataniiru. Akkasumas, dhimmicha irratti qorannoon mootummaa akka godhamu gaafataniiru.

title: Zambia’s Hichilema wins second term as president
english: Zambian President Hakainde Hichilema has secured a second term in office after winning approximately 60 percent of the vote. His primary challenger, Brian Mundubile, received 38 percent and has raised concerns regarding potential electoral fraud. The election process faced significant challenges, including reports of violence, ballot theft, and the brief suspension of vote counting.
amharic: የዛምቢያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሀካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ ወደ 60 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ድምፅ በማግኘት ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የሀገሪቱ መሪ ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። ዋና ተቀናቃኛቸው ብሪያን ሙንዱቢሌ 38 በመቶ ድምፅ ያገኙ ሲሆን በምርጫው ሂደት ላይ የማጭበርበር ክስ አቅርበዋል። ምርጫው በግጭት፣ በድምፅ መስጫ ወረቀት ስርቆት እና ለተወሰነ ጊዜ የድምፅ አቆጣጠር መቋረጥ የታጀበ ነበር።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Zaambiyaa Haakayinde Hichiileemaa sagalee harka 60 ol argachuun yeroo lammaffaaf filatamaniru. Dorgomtuun isaanii ijoon Biriyaanii Munduubiilee sagalee harka 38 kan argatan yoo ta'u, filannoo kana keessatti gowwoomsaan raawwatameera jechuun komii kaasuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Adeemsi filannoo kun walitti bu'iinsa, hattaa waraqaa sagalee fi yeroodhaaf sagalee lakkaa'uun dhaabbachuu kan of keessatti qabatedha.

title: Report: Kushner opposes Netanyahu's plans for ongoing targeted killings in Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu recently informed Jared Kushner that he intends to persist with targeted assassination operations in Gaza. Kushner expressed his disapproval of this strategy during their discussion. Ultimately, the two officials failed to reach a consensus regarding the continuation of these military actions.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በጋዛ ስትሪፕ የታለሙ ግድያዎችን እንደማያቆሙ ለጃሬድ ኩሽነር ተናግረዋል። ኩሽነር በእነዚህ የጥቃት እርምጃዎች ላይ ተቃውሞውን የገለጸ ሲሆን በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ አልተቻለም።
oromo: Mummichi ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun, gaazaa keessatti duula ajjeechaa lafa irratti xiyyeeffate itti fufuuf akka karoorfatan Jaared Kushneritti himaniiru. Kushneris tooftaa kana mormuufi ilaalcha isaa ibsuun, gama lamaan gidduutti waliigalteen tokkollee akka hin uumamne himameera.

title: Iran war live: Trump rejects MoU extension as US claims control of Hormuz
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the United States will not renew its memorandum of understanding with Iran following the agreement's expiration. Trump has demanded that Iran surrender, while claiming his administration is in talks with the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps. However, the IRGC has explicitly denied that any such discussions are taking place.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ እና ከኢራን መካከል የነበረው የመግባቢያ ስምምነት ጊዜው ስላለቀበት እንደማያድሱት አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ኢራን እጇን እንድትሰጥ የጠየቁ ሲሆን ከአገሪቱ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ጋር ውይይት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን ቢገልጹም፣ ዘበኛው ግን ይህንን መረጃ አስተባብሏል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Donaald Traamp waliigalteen gargaarsaa kan Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduu ture xumuramuu isaa hordofee, waliigaltee kana haaromsuuf akka hin barbaanne ibsaniiru. Traamp Iraan akka harka kennattu kan gaafatan yoo ta'u, garee Waraana Wal-abjuu Iraan waliin mari'achaa jiraachuu isaanii himanis, gareen kun garuu mariin akkasii akka hin jirre haaleera.

title: Iran's Araghchi says no justification for 'reckless attack' on Iraq’s Kurdish region
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi condemned a recent attack on the Iraqi Kurdistan prime minister’s office, calling it unjustified and reckless. He urged Kurdish officials to remain alert for hidden attempts to create conflict between the two neighbors. Additionally, Araghchi emphasized Iran's history of supporting the Kurdish people and expressed appreciation for their cooperation in maintaining border security.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቢሮ ላይ የተፈፀመውን ጥቃት አውግዘው፣ ድርጊቱ ምንም አይነት ህጋዊ ምክንያት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል። የኩርድ ባለስልጣናት በሁለቱ ጎረቤት አገራት መካከል መለያየትን ለመፍጠር የሚደረጉ ሴራዎችን እንዲጠነቀቁ አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም አራግቺ ኢራን ለኩርድ ህዝብ ያላትን ድጋፍ በማስታወስ፣ በድንበር ደህንነት ላይ ለሚያደርጉት ትብብር ምስጋናቸውን አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iran Abbaas Araagchi haleellaa biiroo muummee ministiraa Kurdistaan Iraaq irratti raawwatame balaaleeffachuun, gochi kun kan hin fudhatamneefi akka tasaa kan raawwatame ta’uu ibsaniiru. Gaggeessitoonni Kurdii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti walitti bu’iinsa uumuuf yaalii dhokataa godhamuuf of eeggannoo akka taasisan gorseera. Kana malees, Araagchi Iran lammiilee Kurdii cinaa dhaabbachuu ishee yaadachiisuun, nageenya daangaa eeguu irratti gumaacha isaan taasisaniif galata galchaniiru.

title: ‘We will not allow Gaza to be rebuilt’ until Hamas disarms, Kushner says
english: US envoy Jared Kushner has announced that the reconstruction of the Gaza Strip will not proceed until Hamas surrenders its weapons. Although Hamas had previously agreed to disarm as part of a potential peace process, Israel has rejected these terms, insisting on full demilitarization before any progress occurs. Kushner emphasized that the US will continue to support Israel's right to defend itself against threats, despite recent calls from President Trump to halt ongoing airstrikes.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር የጋዛ ሰርጥ መልሶ ግንባታ የሚከናወነው ሃማስ ትጥቁን ሲፈታ ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ሃማስ ቀደም ሲል ትጥቅ ለመፍታት ተስማምቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ እስራኤል ማንኛውም አይነት መሻሻል ከመፈጠሩ በፊት ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ መፍታት እንደሚያስፈልግ በመግለጽ ሀሳቡን ውድቅ አድርጋለች። ኩሽነር አሜሪካ እስራኤል ራሷን የመከላከል መብቷን እንደምትደግፍ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በአየር ጥቃቶቹ ላይ ማቆም እንዳለባቸው ቢጠይቁም ውጥረቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ergamtuun Ameerikaa Jaared Kushner akka ibsetti, deebisanii ijaaruun daangaa Gaazaa kan danda'amu haalli hammaasuun meeshaa waraanaa hiikate yoo mirkanaa'e qofa dha. Hammaas kanaan dura meeshaa hiikachuuf walii galus, Israa'el haala kanaan dura ture fudhachuu diduun guutummaatti meeshaa irraa bilisa ta'uu akka qaban gaafatteetti. Kushner akka jedhetti, Ameerikaan Israa'el of ittisuuf mirga qabdu akka deeggartu ibseera, kunis Prezidaanti Traampin qilleensa irraa haleellaa dhaabuuf gaaffii dhiyeessan keessattuu itti fufeera.

title: Erdogan says Mecca agreement open to Egypt
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has announced that the recently signed Mecca Agreement between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan is available for other nations to join. He specifically addressed reports regarding Egypt, clarifying that the country is welcome to participate in the pact. This statement serves to dismiss rumors suggesting that Egypt was intentionally excluded from the regional agreement.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان በቱርክ፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመው የመካ ስምምነት ለሌሎች አገራትም ክፍት መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በተለይም ግብጽ በዚህ ስምምነት ውስጥ መሳተፍ እንደምትችል በመግለጽ፣ አገሪቷ ከስምምነቱ ውጪ እንደተደረገች የሚናፈሱ ወሬዎችን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ መግለጫ ሌሎች የክልሉ አገራትም በስምምነቱ ለመቀላቀል እድል እንዳላቸው አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rejeeb Xayyib Erdogaan waliigalteen Makkaa kan biyyoota Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame, biyyoota biroofis kan baname ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Keessattuu, biyyi Gibxii waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaachuu akka dandeessu ibsuun, odeeffannoo biyyattiin waliigaltee kana keessaa baate jedhamee tamsa'e dhugaa akka hin taane mirkaneessaniiru. Yaanni kun biyyoonni naannichaa biroo waliigaltee kana keessatti hirmaachuuf carraa akka qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Woman, child injured in Houthi shelling Yemen’s al-Dhale
english: A woman and a child were wounded following a Houthi shelling attack on a residential area in Yemen's Al-Dhale governorate. Local reports indicate that this incident is part of a recent surge in violence by Houthi forces within the Hajar and Murais districts. State media confirmed the attack, highlighting the ongoing threat to civilians in these regions.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በአል-ዳሌ ግዛት በሚገኝ የመኖሪያ አካባቢ ባደረሱት የከባድ መሳሪያ ተኩስ አንዲት ሴት እና አንድ ህፃን ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሃጃር እና ሙራይስ ወረዳዎች እየተባባሰ የመጣው የሁቲዎች ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ አካል መሆኑ ተገልጿል። የየመን የመንግስት ዜና ወኪል እንደዘገበው፣ በሲቪል አካባቢዎች ላይ የሚሰነዘረው ጥቃት ስጋት እየጨመረ መጥቷል።
oromo: Godina Al-Dhale kan Yemen keessatti haleellaa boombii gareen Houthi bakka jiraattoonni keessa jiran irratti raawwateen dubartii fi daa’imni tokko miidhamaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsetti, haleellaan kun naannolee Hajar fi Murais keessatti garee Houthiin babal’achaa jiraachuu argisiisa. Miidiyaan mootummaa akka mirkaneessetti, haleellaan kun jireenya namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: As rubble clears, Colombia begins focusing on recovery after the earthquake
english: One week after a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, emergency teams are transitioning from search and rescue operations to long-term recovery and aid distribution. The disaster has resulted in at least 289 deaths, thousands of injuries, and massive damage to housing, schools, and essential infrastructure across 15 provinces. While rescue crews continue their work, the primary focus is now shifting toward providing shelter for the displaced and beginning the reconstruction process.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰው የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ አንድ ሳምንት ባስቆጠረበት ወቅት፣ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች ወደ ተጎጂዎች እርዳታ እና መልሶ ግንባታ እየተሸጋገሩ ነው። አደጋው ቢያንስ 289 ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን አቁስሎ፣ ቤቶችን፣ ትምህርት ቤቶችን እና መሰረታዊ መሠረተ ልማቶችን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ አውድሟል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ዋናው ትኩረት ለተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ በማቅረብ እና የተጎዱ አካባቢዎችን መልሶ ለመገንባት ላይ ተጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa gama dhihaatti sochiin lafaa humna 7.4 qabu erga mudatee torban tokko booda, tattaaffiin fayyisuu gara gargaarsa namoomaa fi ijaarsa bu'uuraa miti-hawaasummaatti ce'aa jira. Balaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 289 yoo darbu, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawaman miidhamaniiru; akkasumas manni jireenyaa, mana barnootaa fi bu'uuraleen misoomaa bal'inaan barbadaa'aniiru. Yeroo ammaa, xiyyeeffannoon guddaan kanneen qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniif iddoo qubannaa dhiyeessuu fi hojii deebisanii ijaaruu irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha.

title: ‘Truth or fiction’: US trial of Tupac Shakur’s accused killer begins
english: The murder trial of Duane Davis has officially started in Las Vegas, nearly thirty years after the death of legendary rapper Tupac Shakur. Prosecutors argue that Davis acted as the mastermind behind the 1996 drive-by shooting, seeking revenge for a fight involving his nephew. Davis has pleaded not guilty to the murder charges, and the court proceedings are expected to continue for several weeks.
amharic: የታዋቂው ራፐር ቱፓክ ሻኩር ግድያ የጥርጣሬ ተጠርጣሪ የሆነው ዱዌን ዴቪስ የፍርድ ሂደት ከሰላሳ ዓመታት ገደማ በኋላ በላስ ቬጋስ ተጀምሯል። አቃቤ ህግ ዴቪስ በ1996 የራፐሩን ህይወት የቀጠፈውን የሽጉጥ ጥቃት በመምራት የወንድሙን ልጅ በመደብደቡ ለመበቀል እንደተነሳ ይከራከራሉ። ተጠርጣሪው በክሱ ላይ እምቢ ብለዋል፤ የፍርድ ሂደቱ ለሚቀጥሉት በርካታ ሳምንታት እንደሚቆይ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa ragaa du'a rap-artistii beekamaa Tupac Shakur irratti himatamaa Duane Davis jedhamu irratti seeraan banamee jira. Abbaan alangaa akka ibsetti, Duane Davis bara 1996 keessa ajjeechaa Tupac raawwatameef itti gaafatamaa fi qindeessaa akka ture himateera. Himatamaan kun yakka itti dhihaate kan hin fudhanne yoo ta'u, dhaddachi kun torbanoota hedduuf itti fufa jedhamee eegama.

title: Israeli settlers injure two Palestinians, set fire to agricultural lands in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers attacked two Palestinian men in the town of Beita, resulting in injuries that required hospital care. In a separate incident near Ramallah, settlers accompanied by the military burned Palestinian agricultural fields. These events highlight the ongoing violence occurring in the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በቤይታ ከተማ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ወጣቶችን በማጥቃታቸው ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል እንዲሄዱ ተደርጓል። በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጥበቃ ስር ያሉ ሰፋሪዎች በቱርሙስ አያ ከተማ የፍልስጤማውያንን የግብርና መሬቶች በእሳት አቃጥለዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ የሚፈጸሙትን ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el ganda Beitaa keessatti dargaggoota Falasxiin lama irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru, kunis namoonni kun gara mana yaalaa akka geeffaman dirqisiiseera. Kana malees, waraana Israa'el gargaaramuun qotee bulaan kunneen lafa qonnaa kan Falasxiinotaa magaala Turmus Ayyaatti gubaniiru. Gochootni kun walitti bu'iinsa fi miidhaa naannoo West Bank keessatti yeroo ammaa mul'atu ibsu.

title: Erdogan urges Trump to continue talks with Iran, offers support
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan recently spoke with Donald Trump to encourage the United States to maintain diplomatic dialogue with Iran and reduce regional tensions. During their conversation, Erdogan expressed his willingness to assist in peace-building initiatives and raised concerns regarding the escalating violence against Palestinians in Gaza. The two leaders also reviewed their bilateral relations and a new defense agreement involving Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶሃን ከአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር ባደረጉት የስልክ ውይይት፣ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ያላትን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንድትቀጥል እና የክልሉን ውጥረት እንድታረግቡ ጠይቀዋል። ኤርዶሃን በሰላም ማስፈን ሂደቶች ላይ ለመተባበር ፈቃደኛ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በጋዛ በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ እየደረሰ ስላለው ጥቃት ያላቸውን ስጋትም አንስተዋል። መሪዎቹ በሁለቱ ሀገራት የሁለትዮሽ ግንኙነት እንዲሁም በቱርክ፣ በሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል ስለተፈረመው የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Turkii Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Pireezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonald Traamp waliin bilbilan haasa'aniiru. Erdogan, Ameerikaan Iran waliin marii itti fufuun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa akka tasgabbeessitu gaafatanii, carraaqqii nagaa fiduu keessatti gargaarsa gochuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru. Walta'iinsa kanaan, haleellaa Gaza keessatti Palasteenota irratti raawwatamaa jiru irratti yaaddoo qaban ibsuun, hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fi waliigaltee ittisaa kan Turkii, Sa'udii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame irrattis mari'ataniiru.

title: US envoy backs Yemen government’s fight against Houthis
english: A senior US diplomat in Yemen, Neil Hope, met with Yemeni government officials in Riyadh to affirm his support for their military efforts against Houthi forces. He strongly denounced the Houthi movement's ongoing attacks on civilians. Additionally, Hope praised the government's military leadership for their role in resisting Iranian influence within the country.
amharic: በየመን የዩኤስ ኤምባሲ ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማት ኒል ሆፕ፣ ከየመን መንግስት ባለስልጣናት ጋር በሪያድ ተገናኝተው በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ለሚያደርጉት ውጊያ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። ዲፕሎማቱ የሁቲ ቡድን በንጹሃን ዜጎች ላይ የሚፈጽመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የየመን የመንግስት ሃይሎች ኢራን በየመን በኩል የምታራምደውን ተጽዕኖ ለመመከት ለሚያደርጉት ጥረት አድናቆታቸውን ችረዋል።
oromo: Hojjetaan olaanaa iddoo ambaasaaddaraatti argamu kan Yunaayitid Isteets Neil Hoop, qondaaltota mootummaa Yaman waliin Riyaaditti walgayii taasisaniin, lola mootummaan Yaman garee Huutii irratti gaggeessuuf deggarsa qaban mirkaneessaniiru. Gareen Huutii lammilee nagaa irratti haleellaa raawwatu cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru. Kana malees, qondaaltichi loltoonni mootummaa Yaman dhiibbaa Iiraan biyyattii keessatti uumtu ittisuuf carraaqqii godhan cimsanii galateeffataniiru.

title: Palestinian American reunites with family under siege in West Bank
english: A Palestinian-American man named Loui Ridi recently managed to return to his family home in the West Bank village of Qusra. He arrived to find his relatives living under an intense siege by illegal Israeli settlers. The reunion took place amidst significant intimidation and threats directed at his household.
amharic: ሉዊ ሪዲ የተባሉ አሜሪካዊው ፍልስጤማዊ በዌስት ባንክ ቂስራ በተባለ መንደር ከሚገኘው ቤተሰባቸው ጋር ተገናኝተዋል። ወደ ቤታቸው ሲደርሱ ቤተሰቦቻቸው በሕገ-ወጥ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች የተከበቡ መሆናቸውን ተመልክተዋል። ይህ የመገናኘት ሂደት በሰፋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ዛቻ እና ተፅዕኖ ውስጥ ሆኖ የተከናወነ ነው።
oromo: Namni lammii Ameerikaa fi Falastiin ta'e Loui Ridi jedhamu, gara manaa maatii isaa kan baadiyaa Qusra, West Bank jiruutti deebi'eera. Inni yommuu achi ga'u, maatiin isaa qubattoota Israa'el seeraan alaa ta'aniin marfamanii akka jiran argeera. Wal arguun kunis gidduu sodaa fi dhiibbaa cimaa qubattichoonni isaan irratti raawwatan keessatti ta'e.

title: Civilians paying price as Israeli military raises stakes in Lebanon: UNIFIL
english: The United Nations peacekeeping force in Lebanon reports that civilians are suffering due to a sharp increase in cross-border military strikes over the last two weeks. Despite a June ceasefire agreement, daily projectile fire has intensified, forcing many local families to flee their homes or alter their lives for safety. While Hezbollah opposes the current deal, Lebanese officials are calling for an extension of the UN mission to help stabilize the region.
amharic: በሊባኖስ የሚገኘው የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ባለፉት ሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ በተካሄደው የውጊያ መጠን መጨመር ምክንያት ንፁሃን ዜጎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እየደረሰባቸው መሆኑን አስታውቋል። በሰኔ ወር የተደረገ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ በየቀኑ የሚተኮሱት ሚሳኤሎች ቁጥር መጨመሩ ብዙ ቤተሰቦችን እንዲፈናቀሉ ወይም ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ የዕለት ተዕለት ሕይወታቸውን እንዲቀይሩ አስገድዷቸዋል። ሂዝቦላህ ስምምነቱን ቢቃወምም፣ የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን ለማረጋጋት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ተልዕኮ እንዲቀጥል ጥሪ እያቀረቡ ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni naga-eegumsa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa biyya Libaanoon jiran, torban lamaan darban keessa waraanni dabaluun isaa lammiilee nagaa miidhaa cimaaf saaxilaa akka jiru ibsan. Waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa ji'a Waxabajjii godhame iyyuu, guyyaa guyyaatti dhukaasni akka dabaleefi maatiiwwan hedduus manneen isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqamuu ibsameera. Hizaaballaah waligaltee kana kan mormu ta'us, aanga'oonni Libaanoon tasgabbii naannichaa fiduuf ergamni Tokkummaa Mootummootaa akka itti fufu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Trump says Iran will not make the deal he believes is necessary
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that Iran is unlikely to reach a nuclear agreement that meets his requirements. He emphasized that the country must be prevented from developing nuclear weapons at all costs. Trump also claimed that previous American military actions have significantly delayed Iran's ability to rebuild its nuclear program.

Kana malees, tarkaanfiileen waraanaa kanaan dura Ameerikaan fudhatte dandeettii Iraan sagantaa niukleerii ishee deebitee ijaaruuf qabdu harkaa fuudheera jedhaniiru.

title: Trump loses second Supreme Court bid over E Jean Carroll sex abuse case
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has refused to hear Donald Trump's appeal for a second time regarding a 2023 civil case where he was found liable for the sexual abuse and defamation of E. Jean Carroll. This decision confirms the finality of the $5 million jury verdict, which Carroll has already received. While this specific matter is now closed, Trump is still pursuing appeals for a separate defamation judgment involving the same individual.

oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Ameerikaa, Donald Traamp himannaa ejjaan walqabatee fi maqaa xureessuu irratti E. Jeen Kaarooliin kaffaluuf murtaa'e irratti gaaffii isaanii yeroo lammaffaaf fudhachuu dideera. Murtii kanaanis, kaffaltiin miiliyoona $5 ta'e sun kan hin jijjiiramne ta'uun mirkanaa'eera. Dhimmi kun xumura argatus, Traamp himannaa maqaa xureessuu biraa kan namuma kanaa waliin walqabatu irratti mormii isaanii itti fufaniiru.

title: Israeli forces raid Bethlehem rehabilitation hospital
english: Israeli military forces entered the Bethlehem Arab Society for Rehabilitation Hospital on Monday, causing widespread alarm among those inside. Reports indicate that people in the hospital's courtyard were physically attacked during the operation. The Palestinian Ministry of Health has officially denounced the raid, stating that it violates international law and threatens the safety of medical services.
